description: Preset for public SDK and library repositories. Automerges minor and patch dependency updates, runs on a monthly schedule, and groups GitHub Actions updates.
schedule: on the 15th day of the month before 12pm

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Restore Renovate's default immediate behavior for security PRs. The base preset constrains vulnerability alerts to an after-hours schedule, but public SDK repos should not delay security fixes.

packageRules.description: Keep GitHub Actions in their own group rather than the repo-wide 'minor and patch updates' group above. Digests and pins are handled by the base preset.
